verdict.rationale: Jira's feature page says Rovo AI connects relevant assets and data from Confluence, Figma, and third-party apps to your work, and can identify trends. That implies AI working over workspace content, but the evidence never shows a conversational question-and-answer flow or cited answers. missing for 10: explicit ask-a-question/chat answer capability, citations or source links in AI answers, documentation of answer speed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
